description: Count the extraction visits in an apiary season register whose rows mix inspections and extraction runs. DISTILL-CANARY-658dec8c

files.README.md:
Hollowbrook Apiary - records folder

The season register logs every visit to the hives in row order. Extraction
visits are booked with the co-operative and written into the same register.

turns.prompt: Hollowbrook Apiary writes every visit to its hives into one season register. Some visits are inspections and some are extractions done for the co-operative. How many extraction visits does the register hold? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
